background: HSBC UK Bank plc is the ring-fenced retail and commercial bank of HSBC in Britain, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, including first direct.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average with the weakest at A+, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026 and a move to positive outlook by one on 18 Sep 2026. Leverage of 5.6% and NSFR of 143% are in the top quarter of UK majors and LCR of 160% above the median, but CET1 of 13.2% is in the bottom quarter. Since 30 Jun 2025 LCR has fallen 26 points and NSFR 8 points, while capital has held steady (figures to 30 Jun 2026).
